278795625.description:
Longchamp Paris Smoking Pipe Lot
Vintage Algerian Briar Collection
Leather-Wrapped, 3 Pieces, With Original Case
A vintage collection of smoking pipes from The Longchamp Pipe Company, Paris. Renowned for their signature leather-wrapped designs, Longchamp pipes were traditionally crafted using century-old Algerian briar, selected in the Jura mountains and hand-finished in Paris. This lot represents the classic mid-century French pipe-making tradition, highly regarded by collectors for the unique aesthetic and cooling properties of the leather dressing.
Items Included:
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, straight black stem, marked Longchamp France.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Cream-colored bowl with black bit, straight billiard-style silhouette.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, dark brown hand-sewn leather, black stem.
Original Presentation Case: Red exterior clamshell case with green velvet-style lining and branded silk interior lid.
Certificate of Authenticity: Original parchment document from The Longchamp Pipe Company certifying materials and origin.
Condition:
The pipes are in used vintage condition. Bowls show significant charring and carbon buildup from previous use. Stems exhibit tooth marks and light oxidation. The leather wrapping shows surface scuffs, discoloration, and age-related wear consistent with handling. The presentation case has visible staining on the interior silk lining and light exterior shelf wear. The included certificate is folded and shows age-toning but remains fully legible. One slot in the case is vacant.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.
* For combined shipping policy see the shipping tab.

278326957.description: Two raw rough ruby corundum mineral specimens weighing a total of 35.5 grams. One crystal measures approximately 23mm x 17mm, and the other measures 29mm x 19mm. Both crystals exhibit a hexagonal form with deep reddish-purple coloration visible through the host rock matrix. The specimens display strong red fluorescence under UV light and show translucency when backlit. Surfaces retain natural pitting and some host rock, indicating they are unpolished and in their natural, uncut state. These specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, educational use, or gem enthusiasts seeking authentic raw ruby crystals.
